title: rayachain-canary-artifact: code and data for the RayaChain omnichain canary-layer paper
description: Reproducibility artifact for 'RayaChain: An Omnichain Canary Layer for Cross-Chain Risk and Credit Signal Propagation in Decentralized Agentic Finance'. Contains an offline reference encoder for the CAIP-10-based CanarySignal v1 envelope, a synthetic sensitivity analysis of the validator-loss weights, their outputs, protocols (not yet run) for a LayerZero test-network experiment and a historical exploit replay, and a redacted engineering report of a retired testnet run. All results are offline or synthetic; no live or predictive measurements are included. Code: Apache-2.0. Data and documents: CC BY 4.0.
notes: Data and documentation files are licensed CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-data). Co-author ORCID to be added before release.
